notes.raw:
\*Data above 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 942 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.667$ kcal/mol. 1049 K, β - γ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.137$ kcal/mol. 1408 K, melting point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.185$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-1800 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 18.233 + 1.984 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.876 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=18.233\times10^{-3}T+0.992\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.876\times10^{2}T^{-1}-5.818$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-942 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -157.274 + 6.780 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 3.550 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 106.800 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -157.274 - 6.780 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 3.550 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 53.400 \text{T}^{-1} + 84.010 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
942-1049 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -154.864 - 0.365 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.672 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 19.300 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -154.864 + 0.365 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.672 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 9.650 \text{T}^{-1} + 36.549 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1049-1408 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -157.160 + 0.740 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.672 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 19.300 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -157.160 - 0.740 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.672 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 9.650 \text{T}^{-1} + 46.423 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1408-1800 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -155.853 - 1.740 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.672 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 19.300 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -155.853 + 1.740 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.672 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 9.650 \text{T}^{-1} + 27.515 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Settle (106). Other data are from Gronvold (47) who estimated all above 298 K.
